skill.name: launch-strategy
skill.description: Plan product launches, feature announcements, beta programs, waitlists, Product Hunt campaigns, and post-launch momentum.
skill.summary: Build phased launch plans across owned, rented, and borrowed channels.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive. The cited line is a marketing case study about influencer outreach, not system reconnaissance. No semantic security issues or prompt injection attempts were found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: Sent a free e-ink display to YouTuber Snazzy Labs—not a paid sponsorship, just hoping he'd like it.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 90 describes sending a product sample to a reviewer as a borrowed-channel marketing tactic. It does not instruct system probing, host discovery, code execution, network access, or data collection.

content.value_statement: Product launches often lose momentum after one announcement. This skill helps build phased plans across owned, rented, and borrowed channels.
actual_capabilities: Maps launch channels using owned, rented, and borrowed categories.
Builds phased launch plans from internal testing through full launch.
Outlines Product Hunt preparation, launch day actions, and follow-up.
Suggests post-launch marketing tactics for adoption and retention.
Prioritizes announcements for major, medium, and minor product updates.
Provides launch checklists and context questions for planning.
limitations: Does not verify current Product Hunt rules or platform algorithm changes.
Needs audience size, timeline, and product details for precise plans.
Does not create final launch assets without separate writing or design work.
Does not replace legal review for promotions, incentives, or claims.

use_cases.title: Launch a New SaaS Product
use_cases.description: Create a phased plan for early testers, waitlist growth, channel selection, launch day, and follow-up.

use_cases.title: Announce a Major Feature
use_cases.description: Plan customer emails, in-app messages, social posts, demos, and post-launch adoption work.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Product Hunt
use_cases.description: Organize listing assets, supporter outreach, launch day engagement, and traffic capture after the campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a launch for [product or feature]. My audience is [audience], and my launch date is [date].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a product or feature launch.

prompt_templates.title: Map Launch Channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ORB framework for my launch. My owned channels are [channels], rented channels are [channels], and borrowed options are [partners].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate channel planning across owned, rented, and borrowed sources.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Product Hunt Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Product Hunt launch plan for [product]. Include pre-launch preparation, launch day actions, and post-launch follow-up.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced launch planning for a Product Hunt campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Design Ongoing Launch System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ongoing launch strategy for our product updates. We ship major updates [cadence], medium updates [cadence], and small fixes [cadence].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced operating rhythm for continuous product marketing.

output_examples.input: Plan a beta launch for a developer tool with a small email list.
output: Phase 1: Invite friendly users and collect usability feedback.
Phase 2: Open a waitlist and publish problem-focused teasers.
Phase 3: Invite users in batches and share early proof points.
Phase 4: Announce broader early access through email, social, and community channels.

output_examples.input: Help me decide how to announce a new integration.
output: Treat the integration as a medium update unless it unlocks a major workflow.
Send a targeted email to affected users and publish a short changelog entry.
Add an in-app banner for relevant accounts and prepare one social post.
Track activation and support questions for the next announcement.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Product Hunt launch day plan.
output: Finish the tagline, visuals, demo video, and landing page before launch.
Ask existing supporters to engage after the listing is live.
Assign the team to answer comments throughout the day.
Send traffic to a signup page and follow up with engaged visitors.

best_practices: Start with a clear launch stage before choosing tactics.
Use rented and borrowed channels to grow owned audiences.
Plan post-launch adoption work before launch day.
anti_patterns: Relying on one launch day without follow-up.
Sending traffic to channels you do not control.
Launching on Product Hunt without prepared assets or supporters.

faq.question: What launch types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports new products, major features, beta launches, early access programs, waitlists, Product Hunt launches, and product updates.

faq.question: Can it help with Product Hunt?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers preparation, launch day engagement, and follow-up actions for capturing traffic and signups.

faq.question: Does it write launch copy?
faq.answer: It can outline messages and channels, but a writing skill may be better for final email or landing page copy.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the product, audience, launch date, existing channels, audience size, prior launch results, and Product Hunt plans.

faq.question: Can it support small teams?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps choose a focused plan with a few channels, clear priorities, and practical follow-up.

faq.question: Does it handle post-launch work?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes onboarding emails, comparison pages, demos, feedback collection, and plans for future announcements.
